note_tweet.text:
This game appears to have been created with clear hostility toward sexual minorities, particularly gay men. Its content repeatedly relies on derogatory stereotypes, sexual insinuations, and offensive wordplay to ridicule homosexuality.

The game deliberately uses Chinese homophones and puns referring to terms such as “anal sex,” presenting gay men through vulgar and degrading sexual stereotypes. Its store description also previously included the statement “People who don’t play this game are gay,” explicitly using “gay” as an insult.

After the game attracted significant public criticism, the developer removed that sentence from the store description. However, the actual content of the game has not been meaningfully changed, and the material that mocks, stigmatizes, and disparages gay people remains present.

Taken together, these elements do not appear to be isolated jokes or incidental references. They suggest a deliberate attempt to provoke hostility toward sexual minorities and generate attention through discriminatory and inflammatory content. The game has already caused significant controversy in China for these reasons.

I believe this content warrants review under the platform’s policies regarding hateful, discriminatory, or harassing content targeting protected groups.
